description: Our LearnCard badge issuer. This is the only issuer we have, so every credential we send out runs through here first.
eligibility_notes: Select for every course/skill event that should produce a badge.

description: Puts the badge issued by learncard_issuer into the learner's own LearnCard wallet, right after issuance. We use this for our Accounting (ACCY-*) courses, since the Pretend Association of Accountants partnership expects these learner badges to be available to their member employers here.
eligibility_notes: Select alongside learncard_issuer for Accounting (ACCY-*) events. Finance (FINC-*) events pair learncard_issuer with smart_resume instead.

description: SmartResume delivery, where Finance (FINC-*) credentials end up after they're issued through LearnCard. The Pretend Association of Finance partners with SmartResume, so that their members can view learner credentials here.
eligibility_notes: Select for Finance (FINC-*) course and skill events, alongside learncard_issuer. Accounting (ACCY-*) events pair learncard_issuer with learncard_wallet instead.
